verses.gurmukhi: ਡਾਇਣੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਣੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: ddain maanas khaavanee put buraa na ma(n)gai|

en.bdb: The witch is man eater but she also does not contemplate wrong for her son.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਵਿਕਰਮੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਧੀ ਭੈਣਹੁ ਸੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa vikaramee aakheeaai dhee bhainahu sa(n)gai|

en.bdb: Even known as the most vicious man, he also feels ashamed before his daughter and sister.
The kings, trecherous for each other, put no harm to the amabassadors (and they live comfortably).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਉਤਰਨਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਗੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: bajar paap na utaran jai keechan ga(n)gai|

en.bdb: The sins committed at Ganges (the religious places) are as hard as the thunderbolt and never fade out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥਰਹਰ ਕੰਬੈ ਨਰਕੁ ਜਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਢੰਗੈ ।
verses.translit_en: tharahar ka(n)bai narak jam sun ni(n)dhak dda(n)gai |

en.bdb: Listening to the naked meanness of the slanderer, Yama of the hell also trembles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦ ਕੁਢੰਗੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhaa bhalee na kisai dhee gur ni(n)dh kudda(n)gai ||4||

en.bdb: Backbiting of any one is bad but the vilification of the Guru is the worst (way of life).
